params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Background removal sends remove.bg an empty image when the photo's original is not on the disk, and the 400 that comes back (`missing_source`) is reported as a fault. The tile then says the service refused, while the real reason is that there is no original.

## What happens

Nightwatch issue #61 (production, first and last seen 2026-10-10 10:38 UTC, once): `RequestException` 400 from remove.bg, `{"errors":[{"title":"No image given","code":"missing_source",...}]}`, at `app/Http/Helpers/Photo.php:167` (the `->throw()` of the remove.bg call).

`Photo::old_remove_background()` builds `image_file_b64` from `Storage::disk('vehicles')->get($fileName)` without checking that the file is there. When it is missing (or empty), `get()` gives null, the part goes out empty, and remove.bg answers `missing_source`. That code is not in `RemoveBgRefusal::IMAGE_CODES` (rightly: it is about what we sent, not about the image), so it is `report()`ed and the photo gets `SERVICE_REFUSED`.

The fake path in `ProcessImage::fakeRemoveBg()` already checks this and returns `PhotoFailure::SOURCE_MISSING`; the real path does not.

## Expected

The real path checks the original first, the same way: no file (or an empty one) means no call to remove.bg (no credit, no exception), a log line with the photo id, and `SOURCE_MISSING` for the tile. Why the original was gone for this photo is a separate question; this issue is about not spending a call on it and saying the right reason.

Source: Portal mail:12 (a forwarded Nightwatch notification).
params.title: Background removal calls remove.bg with an empty image when the original is missing
